scenes.title: A familiar remote.
scenes.voice: The hardest part of a simple journey should not be asking someone else to plan it.

scenes.title: Their own decision.
scenes.voice: Handback TV puts that decision on a familiar remote. A helper sets the boundaries. The person chooses where to go.

scenes.title: A little setup. A lot more freedom.
scenes.voice: Choose familiar stations, a comfortable walking limit, and the number of changes. Request step free routing, with its limits clearly explained.

scenes.title: The person takes over.
scenes.voice: Now, the person takes over. Choose Green Park with the D pad. No keyboard. No phone. One clear decision.

scenes.title: Real routes. Comfortable limits.
scenes.voice: These journey options come from Transport for London, live. Walking and changes stay within the helper’s limits. The source and freshness stay visible.

scenes.title: One clear step at a time.
scenes.voice: Review the route, then take it one instruction at a time. Where to walk. Which line to take. Which direction to travel.

scenes.title: Read it. Hear it. Stop it.
scenes.voice: Play and pause reads the current instruction, and stops on request. Large focus states keep the next action clear.

scenes.title: A reminder. Never a ticket.
scenes.voice: Save the reviewed route. It is a reminder, never a ticket. Opening it again checks fresh information.

scenes.title: Built for the remote.
scenes.voice: Underneath, a native Android launcher connects remote input and audio to a small web interface. The private Azure preview runs without the laptop.

scenes.title: What if the terms change?
scenes.voice: And here is the part polished demos usually skip. A separate fictional booking lab tests what happens when the terms change after you review them.

scenes.title: A new price needs a new yes.
scenes.voice: We deliberately raise the fare. Handback rejects the old confirmation and asks for a fresh review. It will not quietly agree to a different price.

scenes.title: Success needs a receipt.
scenes.voice: Only then does the browser adapter submit. It reads the provider’s stored receipt before showing success. If the outcome is unknown, another booking is blocked.

scenes.title: Built. Tested. Still learning.
scenes.voice: Thirty three automated tests and real emulator checks support this prototype. Testing with older adults is the next step. No user results are invented.

scenes.title: Give the everyday back.
scenes.voice: A helper sets the boundaries. The person keeps the decision. Handback TV. Give the everyday back.
